title: fix(plugin-detail): a related tab's 「+ 添加」 no longer reads a row's own party as its catalog (#36659)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ82pszhcdkA6eY6pSTqYSy4t)_

Fixes #36659

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在客户的「合同」页签点「添加」，不再弹出一张列着所有客户联系人的选择框，而是直接新建一份属于这个客户的合同；报价、订单、商机的产品明细页签照旧弹出产品选择框。
- 属于记录详情页重做专题，修的是给相关子表页签加「添加」入口时，把合同上必填的「主要联系人」误当成了像产品那样的来源目录。
- 出错的话只是某个页签的「添加」从选择框变成直接新建（或反过来），不碰已有数据，可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

The related tab's 「+ 添加」 (objectstack#35601) derives its picker from the relationship when the page authors no `add` (`derivedAddOf`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`). For a `master_detail` child it took the child's one other required single-valued lookup as the child's **source catalog**: the picker listed that lookup's object and a pick created a child row naming it. That is right for a line's product and wrong for a row's own party: `crm_contract` is `master_detail` to `crm_account` and requires `crm_contact` (its primary contact, `dependsOn: ['crm_account']`). So an account's 合同 tab opened a picker of `crm_contact` with no filter (the reported `GET /api/v1/data/crm_contact?populate=crm_account&top=10&skip=0`), listing other accounts' contacts, and a pick would have tried to create a contract from a contact.

The function's own docblock already stated the condition for a catalog: "the field every row must name, so a pick is a whole row". This PR checks both halves of that sentence before returning a catalog picker:

- **The candidates do not depend on the row.** A required lookup with a `dependsOn` entry, or a `lookupFilters` comparand `{ $record }`, is scoped by the row; the picker lists the catalog for the whole list and cannot apply that scope. Such a lookup is a party of the row, not a catalog (`scopedByRow`).
- **The pick leaves nothing for a person to write.** Every other required field of the child must be filled by the insert: a non-null `defaultValue` or a select option marked `default` (the engine's `applyFieldDefaults`, `packages/objectql/src/engine-select-option-default.test.ts`), `readonly`, or a computed type (`isComputedFieldType`: formula, summary, rollup, autonumber). `required` is the writer's contract, so a contract that still needs its value and dates is filled in on its form, not completed by a pick (`insertDefaults`).

When either fails, `derivedAddOf` returns `undefined`, which is the existing "master_detail with no catalog" path: 「+ 添加」 opens New with the parent filled in. The `lookup` path (pick unlinked children of the list's own object) and an authored `add` are untouched.

Measured against HotCRM 6.6.0 metadata (read, not run): `crm_contract` loses the picker on both counts (contact `dependsOn` the account; `contract_term_months`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `contract_value` required with no default). `crm_opportunity_line_item`, `crm_quote_line_item` keep the product picker (product required, no `dependsOn`, `quantity` required with `defaultValue: 1`, `unit_price` deliberately not `required`).

Changeset: `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch.

## Tests

`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524.test.tsx`, in the existing describe "「+ 添加」 is decided by the relationship":

- a contract-shaped child (master_detail parent, required contact `dependsOn` the parent, required value and start date, autonumber number): 「+ 添加」 calls New, opens no picker, and no read of `contact` is made;
- `derivedAddOf` returns `undefined` for a required lookup scoped by `dependsOn`, and for one whose `lookupFilters` reads `$record`;
- `derivedAddOf` returns `undefined` when another required field has no default;
- control: a line whose other required fields default (`defaultValue`, select option `default`), are `readonly` or computed, and whose product carries a static `lookupFilters`, keeps `{ picker: { object: 'product' }, linkField: 'product' }`. The existing catalog test ("master_detail with a catalog: the picker lists the catalog…") passes unchanged.

Reverse verification: with the fix committed, `RelatedList.tsx` restored from `origin/main` and the file run, then restored from `HEAD` (`git diff HEAD` empty): the 4 new defect tests fail, the control and the 17 existing tests pass.

## Acceptance notes

- Not changed here, noted: the derived catalog picker does not carry the catalog lookup's own static `lookupFilters` (for example HotCRM's `crm_product` lookup `is_active = true` on opportunity lines), so it can offer a retired product. Read from code, not reproduced in a browser.
- Not changed here, noted: the reported empty, English 「NAME」 column follows from the wrong object (contacts have no `name`); with the contract tab no longer opening a picker it does not appear there.
- Found while verifying, not changed here (same tab, the `lookup` arm this PR does not touch): on an opportunity's 合同 tab, 「+ 添加」 lists unlinked contracts of **every** account (HotCRM 6.6.0, opportunity "Initech Cloud Migration": the picker offers CTR-0004 of Stark Medical next to CTR-0003 of Initech Solutions; request `GET /api/v1/data/crm_contract?populate=crm_account&top=10&skip=0&filter=[["crm_opportunity","is_empty"]]`), although `crm_contract.crm_opportunity` declares `dependsOn: ['crm_account']`. The same picker's first column is headed 「NAME」 and is empty, because the derived picker's label field falls back to `name` and a contract's name field is `contract_number`. Reported to the seat for filing.
- The HotCRM-side card objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2747 (declare that master-detail children offer no "link existing") is not needed for the contract tab after this change; whether it is still wanted is that card's call.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, `derivedAddOf`: the two new early returns (riskiest hunk: `leftToWrite`, which decides which existing line tabs keep their picker).
2. `scopedByRow` and `insertDefaults` just below it.

Browser, HotCRM 6.6.0 (`d513851`, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) behind this branch's Console (Vite, `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`), zh-CN, at `961e6e57`:

- Account "Acme Corporation" → 合同 tab → 「+ 添加」: the 新建合同 form opens with 所属客户 = Acme Corporation filled in and 主要联系人 empty; no picker dialog (`[data-testid="record-picker-dialog"]` count 0); the requests after the click are the record page's own reads, no `GET /api/v1/data/crm_contact`.
- The served schema carries what the rule reads: `GET /api/v1/meta/objects/crm_contract` → `crm_contact` `required: true`, `dependsOn: ["crm_account"]`; `contract_value`, `start_date` `required: true` with no default.
- Before (`origin/main`, the card's own repro on 18.6.0): the same click opened 「添加」 listing contacts of two accounts.

Screenshots are attached in the project thread (GitHub's image store takes browser uploads only): the account's 合同 tab; the New contract form after 「+ 添加」.

Two-minute check: on a HotCRM account, open the 合同 tab and click 「+ 添加」: the New contract form opens with the account filled in, no picker. On an opportunity's product lines tab, 「+ 添加」 still opens the product picker.
